ravenloft.power.dhampir.name: dhampir

effect.summary: A vampiric bite can drain life from a target.

ravenloft.power.dhampir.cost_or_limit: The passage mentions a powerful hunger but gives no mechanics here.
ravenloft.power.dhampir.mind: A strong hunger accompanies the transformation.
ravenloft.power.dhampir.who_may: A character who has become a dhampir.
ravenloft.power.dhampir.where_from: A remarkable event or transformation associated with vampirism.
ravenloft.power.dhampir.combines: Replaces a former race; some prior traits may persist by Ancestral Legacy.
ravenloft.power.dhampir.blocked_reason: The mentioned life-draining bite fits the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.hexblood.name: Hexblood

effect.summary: A lineage presented as a possible transformed character origin; no abilities are described in this passage.

ravenloft.power.hexblood.who_may: A character who gains this lineage.
ravenloft.power.hexblood.where_from: A remarkable event; specifics are not given here.
ravenloft.power.hexblood.blocked_reason: No usable effect for this lineage is described in the passage.

ravenloft.power.reborn.name: Reborn

effect.summary: A lineage presented as a possible transformed character origin; no abilities are described in this passage.

ravenloft.power.reborn.who_may: A character who gains this lineage.
ravenloft.power.reborn.where_from: A remarkable event; specifics are not given here.
ravenloft.power.reborn.blocked_reason: No usable effect for this lineage is described in the passage.

ravenloft.power.dark-gifts.name: Dark Gifts

effect.summary: Supernatural gifts from the Dark Powers are mentioned, but no specific gift is described here.

ravenloft.power.dark-gifts.cost_or_limit: Described generally as double-edged; details are elsewhere.
ravenloft.power.dark-gifts.who_may: Characters chosen or affected by the Dark Powers.
ravenloft.power.dark-gifts.blocked_reason: The passage names the category but gives no specific gift or effect.

ravenloft.power.cure-wounds.name: cure wounds

effect.summary: The spell restores a creature's wounds, but it does not work on Constructs.

ravenloft.power.cure-wounds.cost_or_limit: Does not affect creatures of the Construct type.
ravenloft.power.cure-wounds.who_may: Spellcasters able to cast the spell.
ravenloft.power.cure-wounds.combines: Its restriction depends on creature type.
ravenloft.power.cure-wounds.blocked_reason: Restoring vitality to a touched target fits the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.ancestral-legacy.name: Ancestral Legacy

effect.summary: Retain eligible proficiencies and movement speeds, or gain two skill proficiencies.

ravenloft.power.ancestral-legacy.cost_or_limit: The retained options depend on the replaced race.
ravenloft.power.ancestral-legacy.who_may: Dhampirs, hexbloods, and reborn using a lineage.
ravenloft.power.ancestral-legacy.combines: Can preserve skill proficiencies and climbing, flying, or swimming speeds.
ravenloft.power.ancestral-legacy.blocked_reason: The trait is a choice of retained proficiencies or granted proficiencies.

ravenloft.power.darkvision.name: Darkvision

effect.summary: See in dim light and darkness within 60 feet, with darkness appearing in shades of gray.

ravenloft.power.darkvision.cost_or_limit: Limited to 60 feet; colors appear gray in darkness.

ravenloft.power.deathless-nature.name: Deathless Nature

effect.summary: Gain defenses against disease, poison, and death, and no longer need food, drink, air, or sleep.

ravenloft.power.deathless-nature.cost_or_limit: A long rest can take four hours while motionless and conscious.
ravenloft.power.deathless-nature.mind: Magic cannot put the reborn to sleep; consciousness remains during the rest.
ravenloft.power.deathless-nature.combines: Includes poison resistance, advantages against disease, poison, and death saves.
ravenloft.power.deathless-nature.blocked_reason: The listed benefits are direct protection and removal of ordinary needs.

ravenloft.power.spider-climb.name: Spider Climb

effect.summary: Gain a climbing speed equal to walking speed and, from level 3, move across walls and ceilings hands-free.

ravenloft.power.spider-climb.cost_or_limit: Hands-free wall and ceiling movement begins at level 3.

ravenloft.power.vampiric-bite.name: Vampiric Bite

effect.summary: A bite can restore hit points or boost a subsequent check or attack by its damage amount.

ravenloft.power.vampiric-bite.cost_or_limit: Limited uses equal to proficiency bonus, recovered after a long rest; empowerment only works against non-Construct, non-Undead targets.
ravenloft.power.vampiric-bite.combines: The bite is a proficient natural weapon; it uses Constitution for attack and damage, and is advantaged when half or more hit points are missing.
ravenloft.power.vampiric-bite.blocked_reason: The bite’s hit-point recovery or bonus can be resolved as a basic effect.

ravenloft.power.eerie-token.name: Eerie Token

effect.summary: Create an imbued token from hair, a nail, or a tooth to message its carrier or remotely see and hear from its location.

ravenloft.power.eerie-token.cost_or_limit: One token per long rest; it expires at the next long rest, and remote viewing destroys it when the trance ends.
ravenloft.power.eerie-token.go_wrong: Remote viewing blinds and deafens the user to their own surroundings.
ravenloft.power.eerie-token.combines: The token’s carrier can receive a short telepathic message; both functions require a 10-mile range.
ravenloft.power.eerie-token.blocked_reason: Remote viewing grants perception from a distant object while displacing the user’s own senses.

ravenloft.power.telepathic-message.name: Telepathic Message

effect.summary: Send a brief telepathic message to the token’s carrier within ten miles.

ravenloft.power.telepathic-message.cost_or_limit: Up to 25 words; requires an active token and a 10-mile range.
ravenloft.power.telepathic-message.mind: The carrier receives the message telepathically.
ravenloft.power.telepathic-message.combines: The target must hold or carry the token.
ravenloft.power.telepathic-message.blocked_reason: A short-range communication effect fits the basic information effect.

ravenloft.power.remote-viewing.name: Remote Viewing

effect.summary: See and hear from the token’s location during a brief trance.

ravenloft.power.remote-viewing.cost_or_limit: One minute; the token must be within ten miles; the trance ends if dismissed or incapacitated.
ravenloft.power.remote-viewing.go_wrong: The user is blinded and deafened to their own surroundings; the token is destroyed when the trance ends.
ravenloft.power.remote-viewing.mind: The user enters a trance and loses awareness of local sight and sound.
ravenloft.power.remote-viewing.combines: Requires a token created with Eerie Token.
ravenloft.power.remote-viewing.blocked_reason: The effect relocates the user’s senses to a distant token.

ravenloft.power.hex-magic.name: Hex Magic

effect.summary: Cast disguise self or hex using this lineage feature.

ravenloft.power.hex-magic.cost_or_limit: Each spell can be cast once per long rest through the trait; spell slots can also be used.
ravenloft.power.hex-magic.combines: Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
ravenloft.power.hex-magic.blocked_reason: The named spells provide the operative effects.

ravenloft.power.disguise-self.name: disguise self

effect.summary: Create a magical disguise.

ravenloft.power.disguise-self.cost_or_limit: Hexbloods can use Hex Magic once per long rest for this spell, or expend a spell slot.
ravenloft.power.disguise-self.who_may: Hexbloods using Hex Magic or spell slots.
ravenloft.power.disguise-self.combines: Hex Magic grants access to it.
ravenloft.power.disguise-self.blocked_reason: The effect changes apparent form, beyond the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.hex.name: hex

effect.summary: Cast the named hex spell.

ravenloft.power.hex.cost_or_limit: Hexbloods can use Hex Magic once per long rest for this spell, or expend a spell slot.
ravenloft.power.hex.who_may: Hexbloods using Hex Magic or spell slots.
ravenloft.power.hex.combines: Hex Magic grants access to it.
ravenloft.power.hex.blocked_reason: The passage names the spell but does not describe its specific effect.

ravenloft.power.knowledge-from-a-past-li.name: Knowledge from a Past Life

effect.summary: Add a d6 to a skill check after seeing the d20 result.

ravenloft.power.knowledge-from-a-past-li.cost_or_limit: Uses equal proficiency bonus; recover after a long rest.
ravenloft.power.knowledge-from-a-past-li.mind: Brief memories from past lives or earlier times surface.
ravenloft.power.knowledge-from-a-past-li.combines: Applies to ability checks using a skill.
ravenloft.power.knowledge-from-a-past-li.blocked_reason: A limited numerical bonus can be resolved directly.

ravenloft.power.dark-gift.name: Dark Gift

effect.summary: A supernatural benefit accompanied by an insidious influence.

ravenloft.power.dark-gift.cost_or_limit: May demand service or a future favor; accepting a new gift replaces an existing one.
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.go_wrong: Its influence may carry terrible prices or unwanted consequences.
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.mind: Each gift may have an insidious influence.
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.who_may: Characters who choose one or accept an offer.
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.where_from: Dark Powers, a Darklord, a shrine, a curse, or another mysterious force.
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.combines: A character can replace an existing Dark Gift by accepting another bargain.
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.mechanism: power grant with bargain and replacement
ravenloft.power.dark-gift.blocked_reason: The gift is granted or replaced through a bargain, a transfer of supernatural ability.

ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.name: Echoing Soul

effect.summary: Gain two skill proficiencies, an extra language, and occasionally experience intrusive memories.

ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.cost_or_limit: Intrusive echoes trigger after a natural 1 on an attack, check, or save and recur only after a short or long rest.
ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.go_wrong: Echoes can charm or frighten, distort perception, impede movement, incapacitate, or permit a reroll.
ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.mind: Memories can overtake perception and disorient the character.
ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.where_from: A linked, reincarnating, exchanged, merged, or fractured soul.
ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.combines: The echo type is selected or rolled; outcomes use the Intrusive Echoes table.
ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.mechanism: memory intrusion and triggered mental conditions
ravenloft.power.echoing-soul.blocked_reason: Some outcomes impose charm and fear directly on the character.

effect.summary: Gain proficiency in two chosen skills.
Learn one additional language.

ravenloft.power.intrusive-echoes.name: Intrusive Echoes

effect.summary: A natural 1 on an attack, check, or save triggers a random memory-driven effect.

ravenloft.power.intrusive-echoes.cost_or_limit: After an effect, it cannot recur until a short or long rest.
ravenloft.power.intrusive-echoes.go_wrong: Effects can cause charm, fear, blindness to actual surroundings, reduced speed, or incapacitation; one result grants a reroll.
ravenloft.power.intrusive-echoes.mind: Intruding memories alter perception and behavior.
ravenloft.power.intrusive-echoes.mechanism: triggered mental conditions and memory effects
ravenloft.power.intrusive-echoes.blocked_reason: Some table outcomes impose charm or fear.

ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.name: Gathered Whispers

effect.summary: Gain spirit-mediated messaging and a defensive howl, with voices that sometimes cause adverse effects.

ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.cost_or_limit: Defensive howl is usable once per long rest after it makes an attack miss; voice effects recur after a short or long rest.
ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.go_wrong: Voices can cause disadvantage, deafness, or fear, though they may also provide an omen.
ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.mind: The character hears haunting voices and may be overwhelmed by them.
ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.where_from: Departed souls or other spiritual beings.
ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.combines: Spirits are usually invisible and intangible; the character may allow them to speak through them.
ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.mechanism: spirit communication and triggered mental effects
ravenloft.power.gathered-whispers.blocked_reason: The gift can impose fear and other mental conditions.

ravenloft.power.spirit-whispers.name: Spirit Whispers

effect.summary: Cast message without components, with the spirits delivering the communication.

ravenloft.power.spirit-whispers.cost_or_limit: Uses the message cantrip’s ordinary casting requirements other than components.
ravenloft.power.spirit-whispers.mind: The whispers are perceptible to the character.
ravenloft.power.spirit-whispers.combines: Grants the message cantrip if not already known.
ravenloft.power.spirit-whispers.blocked_reason: A communication spell fits the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.sudden-cacophony.name: Sudden Cacophony

effect.summary: Use a reaction to add proficiency bonus to AC against an attack, potentially making it miss.

ravenloft.power.sudden-cacophony.cost_or_limit: Once it makes an attack miss, it recharges after a long rest.
ravenloft.power.sudden-cacophony.go_wrong: Does not work against an attacker who is deafened.
ravenloft.power.sudden-cacophony.mind: The spirits howl through the character.
ravenloft.power.sudden-cacophony.blocked_reason: A bounded defensive modifier fits the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.voices-from-beyond.name: Voices from Beyond

effect.summary: A natural 1 on an attack, check, or save triggers a random voice effect.

ravenloft.power.voices-from-beyond.cost_or_limit: After an effect, none recur until a short or long rest.
ravenloft.power.voices-from-beyond.go_wrong: May impose disadvantage, deafness, or fear; may instead provide an omen about a planned action.
ravenloft.power.voices-from-beyond.mind: The voices can overwhelm the character’s perceptions.
ravenloft.power.voices-from-beyond.combines: The omen is equivalent to an augury spell.
ravenloft.power.voices-from-beyond.blocked_reason: One outcome provides an omen about the result of a future course of action.

ravenloft.power.augury.name: augury

effect.summary: Receive an omen about a planned course of action.

ravenloft.power.augury.cost_or_limit: Here it is available through Voices from Beyond for an action planned within 30 minutes and asked about within ten minutes.
ravenloft.power.augury.who_may: Characters whose Voices from Beyond result grants it.
ravenloft.power.augury.combines: The spirits deliver its omen as whispers perceptible only to the character.
ravenloft.power.augury.blocked_reason: The effect reveals an omen about a future course of action.

ravenloft.power.living-shadow.name: Living Shadow

effect.summary: Gain a shadow that acts independently at times and can be directed to assist or hinder.

ravenloft.power.living-shadow.cost_or_limit: Shadow Strike uses are limited to proficiency bonus per long rest; Ominous Will recurs after a short or long rest.
ravenloft.power.living-shadow.go_wrong: The shadow may act threateningly, break small objects, or affect checks and attacks unpredictably.
ravenloft.power.living-shadow.mind: The shadow acts out impulses or behaves independently.
ravenloft.power.living-shadow.combines: Grants Grasping Shadow, Shadow Strike, and Ominous Will.
ravenloft.power.living-shadow.blocked_reason: The gift includes a persistent independent shadow with varied behaviors that lack a single defined effect.

ravenloft.power.grasping-shadow.name: Grasping Shadow

effect.summary: Cast mage hand without components, producing a shadowy hand.

ravenloft.power.grasping-shadow.cost_or_limit: Uses the mage hand cantrip’s ordinary limits.
ravenloft.power.grasping-shadow.combines: The created hand is not bound to the character’s actual shadow.
ravenloft.power.grasping-shadow.blocked_reason: A limited remote hand effect fits the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.mage-hand.name: mage hand

effect.summary: Create a magical hand that can manipulate objects at a distance.

ravenloft.power.mage-hand.who_may: Characters with Grasping Shadow, if not already known.
ravenloft.power.mage-hand.blocked_reason: The hand’s limited manipulation can be represented by a basic effect.

ravenloft.power.shadow-strike.name: Shadow Strike

effect.summary: Extend melee reach by ten feet for one attack through the shadow.

ravenloft.power.shadow-strike.cost_or_limit: Uses equal proficiency bonus, recovered after a long rest.
ravenloft.power.shadow-strike.combines: The shadow stretches to deliver the attack.
ravenloft.power.shadow-strike.blocked_reason: An extended attack reach is a direct range modification.

ravenloft.power.ominous-will.name: Ominous Will

effect.summary: After a natural 1, randomly increase or reduce the next roll made nearby.

ravenloft.power.ominous-will.cost_or_limit: One affected roll; recharges after a short or long rest.
ravenloft.power.ominous-will.go_wrong: The d4 result can help or hinder the character or another nearby creature.
ravenloft.power.ominous-will.mind: The shadow asserts its own will.
ravenloft.power.ominous-will.combines: Affects the next attack, check, or save by the character or a visible creature within 30 feet.
ravenloft.power.ominous-will.blocked_reason: A bounded numerical alteration to a roll fits the basic grammar.

ravenloft.power.mist-walker.name: Mist Walker

effect.summary: Navigate the Mists toward a chosen domain, but prolonged stays cause the surrounding area to drain vitality.

ravenloft.power.mist-walker.cost_or_limit: The drain begins after weeks in an area equal to Constitution modifier, minimum one; continued long rests require DC 15 Constitution saves.
ravenloft.power.mist-walker.go_wrong: Failure causes exhaustion that cannot be removed while remaining in the area.
ravenloft.power.mist-walker.mind: May be pursued or have memories of home fractured, depending on origin.
ravenloft.power.mist-walker.where_from: Knowledge of, escape through, community experience with, or abduction by the Mists.
ravenloft.power.mist-walker.combines: Mist Traveler cannot cross domain borders closed by a Darklord’s will.
ravenloft.power.mist-walker.mechanism: mist navigation and regional vitality drain
ravenloft.power.mist-walker.blocked_reason: The gift causes a persistent ten-mile regional field that drains vitality after a delay.

ravenloft.power.misty-step.name: Misty Step

effect.summary: Teleport a short distance as the named spell.

ravenloft.power.misty-step.cost_or_limit: Mist Walker grants one use per long rest without a spell slot; spell slots can also be used.
ravenloft.power.misty-step.combines: Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as spellcasting ability.
ravenloft.power.misty-step.blocked_reason: A self-teleport effect fits the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.mist-traveler.name: Mist Traveler

effect.summary: Treat entry into the Mists as if carrying a talisman keyed to a chosen domain.

ravenloft.power.mist-traveler.cost_or_limit: Must know the destination domain’s name; cannot cross borders shut by a Darklord.
ravenloft.power.mist-traveler.combines: Functions like a Mist talisman keyed to the selected domain.
ravenloft.power.mist-traveler.blocked_reason: The text relies on special domain-travel and border mechanics not represented by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.power.poisoned-roots.name: Poisoned Roots

effect.summary: After resting in an area for a limited number of weeks, risk gaining exhaustion from its vitality drain.

ravenloft.power.poisoned-roots.cost_or_limit: A ten-mile radius; delay is Constitution modifier in weeks, minimum one; DC 15 Constitution save after each later long rest.
ravenloft.power.poisoned-roots.go_wrong: Failed saves cause exhaustion that cannot be removed in the area.
ravenloft.power.poisoned-roots.combines: The affected area changes when the character finishes a long rest.
ravenloft.power.poisoned-roots.blocked_reason: A persistent ten-mile regional field applies a delayed vitality drain.

ravenloft.power.second-skin.name: Second Skin

effect.summary: Assume an alternate form through alter self, sometimes involuntarily.

ravenloft.power.second-skin.cost_or_limit: Voluntary use once per long rest without a spell slot; certain catalysts can force another use after a failed DC 15 Charisma save.
ravenloft.power.second-skin.go_wrong: The character may change involuntarily and retain a visible mark after the spell ends.
ravenloft.power.second-skin.mind: The alternate form may express a hidden drive or nature.
ravenloft.power.second-skin.where_from: A hidden or exaggerated side of the character.
ravenloft.power.second-skin.combines: The form may be chosen or rolled; change catalysts can trigger involuntary transformation.
ravenloft.power.second-skin.blocked_reason: The gift changes the character’s body into an alternate form.

ravenloft.power.transformation.name: Transformation

effect.summary: Cast alter self to assume a second form, using only its appearance-changing option.

ravenloft.power.transformation.cost_or_limit: One free use per long rest; spell slots can also be used; a visible mark may remain until a long rest.
ravenloft.power.transformation.go_wrong: A cosmetic feature remains after the spell ends and may need concealment.
ravenloft.power.transformation.combines: The feature restricts alter self to Change Appearance.
ravenloft.power.transformation.blocked_reason: The effect changes the character’s form and appearance.

ravenloft.power.alter-self.name: alter self

effect.summary: Change appearance using the named spell.

ravenloft.power.alter-self.cost_or_limit: Second Skin’s free use is once per long rest; spell slots may also be used.
ravenloft.power.alter-self.go_wrong: Second Skin may leave a visible mark after the spell ends.
ravenloft.power.alter-self.combines: Second Skin restricts the spell to its appearance-changing option.
ravenloft.power.alter-self.blocked_reason: The spell changes the user’s apparent form.

ravenloft.power.involuntary-change.name: Involuntary Change

effect.summary: A catalyst may force an alter self casting at the start of the next turn after a failed save.

ravenloft.power.involuntary-change.cost_or_limit: DC 15 Charisma save; triggered by a selected or rolled catalyst.
ravenloft.power.involuntary-change.go_wrong: The character may transform despite having already used the feature.
ravenloft.power.involuntary-change.blocked_reason: A failed save forces a body-form change.

ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.name: Symbiotic Being

effect.summary: A separate being shares the character’s body, offers counsel, and may aid or compel them.

ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.cost_or_limit: Cannot be removed while the gift remains; if the character dies, the symbiote dies too.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.go_wrong: The symbiote may impose its agenda through charm; it returns elsewhere on the body if severed.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.mind: The symbiote has its own personality, agenda, and mental scores; it may charm the character.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.where_from: An attached, internal, or otherwise cohabiting being.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.combines: The symbiote shares the character’s senses and can spend the character’s Hit Die to improve a failed save once per long rest.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.mechanism: bound cohabitant, assistance, and mental compulsion
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-being.blocked_reason: The symbiote can charm its host and compel obedience to its commands.

ravenloft.power.entwined-existence.name: Entwined Existence

effect.summary: The symbiote shares the host’s sight and hearing and provides knowledge and a skill proficiency.

ravenloft.power.entwined-existence.cost_or_limit: The symbiote depends on the host to survive; it speaks, reads, and understands two languages.
ravenloft.power.entwined-existence.go_wrong: The symbiote dies if the host dies, but returns if the host is restored to life.
ravenloft.power.entwined-existence.mind: The symbiote has its own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.
ravenloft.power.entwined-existence.combines: The host gains proficiency in one skill selected from a list.
ravenloft.power.entwined-existence.blocked_reason: Shared senses and skill knowledge can be handled as basic sensory and information effects.

ravenloft.power.sustained-symbiosis.name: Sustained Symbiosis

effect.summary: Spend the host’s Hit Die to add its roll to a failed saving throw, potentially succeeding.

ravenloft.power.sustained-symbiosis.cost_or_limit: Once a save succeeds through this trait, it recharges after a long rest.
ravenloft.power.sustained-symbiosis.go_wrong: The host expends a Hit Die; on a death save, success also restores one hit point.
ravenloft.power.sustained-symbiosis.mind: The symbiote acts to protect the host.
ravenloft.power.sustained-symbiosis.mechanism: saving throw assistance with resource expenditure
ravenloft.power.sustained-symbiosis.blocked_reason: A limited bonus to a roll is directly representable.

ravenloft.power.symbiotic-agenda.name: Symbiotic Agenda

effect.summary: If the host ignores an opportunity to advance the symbiote’s agenda, a failed save leaves the host charmed and trying to obey.

ravenloft.power.symbiotic-agenda.cost_or_limit: Save DC 12 plus the symbiote’s Charisma modifier; charm lasts 1d12 hours and can be retried after non-self-inflicted damage.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-agenda.go_wrong: The host may be compelled to follow the symbiote’s commands.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-agenda.mind: The symbiote may charm the host.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-agenda.combines: An agenda may involve destruction, knowledge, prophecy, protection, safety, or experience.
ravenloft.power.symbiotic-agenda.blocked_reason: The trait imposes charm and behavioral compulsion.

ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.name: Touch of Death

effect.summary: Damage creatures with necrotic power through touch or while grappling.

ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.cost_or_limit: Damage scales at character levels 5, 11, and 17.
ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.go_wrong: Bare-skin contact harms those touched; the power is described as beyond control.
ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.mind: The gift may be associated with grim omens or the memory of someone harmed.
ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.where_from: Alchemical alteration, magic, prophecy, near-death, temporal distortion, or other origins.
ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.combines: Necrotic attacks ignore the target’s resistance; grappling also causes damage.
ravenloft.power.touch-of-death.blocked_reason: The described damage and resistance interaction can be resolved directly.

ravenloft.power.death-touch.name: Death Touch

effect.summary: Make an unarmed strike that deals extra necrotic damage on a hit.

ravenloft.power.death-touch.cost_or_limit: Extra damage rises from 1d10 to 4d10 at levels 1, 5, 11, and 17.
ravenloft.power.death-touch.combines: The unarmed strike deals its additional damage on a hit.

ravenloft.power.inescapable-death.name: Inescapable Death
