ravenloft.rule.darklords-are-tormented.blocked_reason: The rule entails continuing, individualized psychological harm rather than a simple discrete effect.

ravenloft.rule.darklords-influence-domai.name: Darklords Influence Domains

effect.summary: Darklords exert considerable influence over their domains and may bar others from leaving.

ravenloft.rule.darklords-influence-domai.cost_or_limit: The form and extent of influence vary.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-influence-domai.go_wrong: A Darklord may close off escape.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-influence-domai.where_from: Their authority, magic, or fundamental connection to the domain.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-influence-domai.combines: The Dark Powers also shape the domain.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-influence-domai.blocked_reason: The influence can govern a whole domain and its boundaries.

ravenloft.rule.darklords-are-immortal.name: Darklords Are Immortal

effect.summary: A fallen Darklord is eventually restored by the Dark Powers.

ravenloft.rule.darklords-are-immortal.cost_or_limit: A defeat lasts only until restoration.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-are-immortal.mind: Many Darklords do not understand how often they have died or lived.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-are-immortal.combines: Their domains may become vulnerable during their absence.
ravenloft.rule.darklords-are-immortal.blocked_reason: The rule requires a persistent death-and-return state controlled by external powers.

ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.name: Lineages replace a character's race

effect.summary: A lineage can replace a character's previous race and its traits.

ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.cost_or_limit: Some former traits may remain through Ancestral Legacy.
ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.go_wrong: A character may lose former racial capabilities.
ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.who_may: Characters who choose or acquire a lineage.
ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.where_from: Character creation or events during play.
ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.combines: Ability scores, languages, and creature type follow lineage rules.
ravenloft.rule.lineages-replace-a-charac.blocked_reason: The rule changes a character's ongoing form and racial state.

ravenloft.rule.darklord-corruption.name: Darklord corruption

effect.summary: The Dark Powers do not force evil; when wickedness ripens, they engulf the evildoer.

ravenloft.rule.darklord-corruption.cost_or_limit: The act must be intentional, unnecessary, successful, and significantly harmful to qualify as evil.
ravenloft.rule.darklord-corruption.combines: Creates a Darklord and a prison domain.
ravenloft.rule.darklord-corruption.blocked_reason: This is a world rule rather than a character effect.

ravenloft.rule.darklord-redemption.name: Darklord redemption

effect.summary: Before final corruption, atonement requires responsibility, repairing harm, and preventing future harm; a Darklord cannot redeem themself.

ravenloft.rule.darklord-redemption.cost_or_limit: Redemption is possible only before becoming a Darklord.
ravenloft.rule.darklord-redemption.who_may: An evildoer before becoming a Darklord.
ravenloft.rule.darklord-redemption.where_from: The Dark Powers' capture of the evildoer.
ravenloft.rule.darklord-redemption.mechanism: Irreversible state change and redemption limit.
ravenloft.rule.darklord-redemption.blocked_reason: This is a world rule rather than a character effect.

ravenloft.rule.birth-of-a-darklord.name: Birth of a Darklord

effect.summary: After an irredeemable act, the Mists draw the evildoer and possibly nearby land into the Domains of Dread.

ravenloft.rule.birth-of-a-darklord.cost_or_limit: Occurs upon completion of the Darklord's greatest irredeemable act.
ravenloft.rule.birth-of-a-darklord.go_wrong: The Darklord becomes a prisoner in a domain.
ravenloft.rule.birth-of-a-darklord.combines: Dark Powers and a prison domain.
ravenloft.rule.birth-of-a-darklord.blocked_reason: The trigger and transport can be represented by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.mist-talisman-travel.name: Mist talisman travel

effect.summary: A Mist talisman can lead its bearer through the Mists to a particular Domain of Dread.

ravenloft.rule.mist-talisman-travel.cost_or_limit: A talisman is associated with a particular domain.
ravenloft.rule.mist-talisman-travel.who_may: The bearer of a Mist talisman.
ravenloft.rule.mist-talisman-travel.combines: Certain trinkets may be Mist talismans at the DM's discretion.
ravenloft.rule.mist-talisman-travel.blocked_reason: The described travel is a world rule and can be represented as movement.

ravenloft.rule.deathless-returns.name: Deathless Returns

effect.summary: Those who die in a domain return reincarnated and repeat a version of their former lives.

ravenloft.rule.deathless-returns.cost_or_limit: Applies to those who die in a domain.
ravenloft.rule.deathless-returns.who_may: Those who die in a domain.
ravenloft.rule.deathless-returns.blocked_reason: Reincarnation and continuity of identity require a soul-state capability.

effect.summary: A Darklord's psychology does not change and their wounds do not heal despite effective immortality.

ravenloft.rule.static-inhabitants.name: Static inhabitants

effect.summary: Inhabitants do not develop or reach their goals, and forces maintain the domain's status quo.

ravenloft.rule.static-inhabitants.blocked_reason: The passage describes a persistent denial of development and change, which basic effects cannot represent.

ravenloft.rule.closed-domain-borders.name: Closed domain borders

effect.summary: Closed borders turn travelers back; the Mists obscure, exhaust, and confound them.

ravenloft.rule.closed-domain-borders.cost_or_limit: A DC 20 Constitution save is required at the start of each turn in the Mists; exhaustion cannot be removed there.
ravenloft.rule.closed-domain-borders.go_wrong: Travelers can accrue exhaustion and cannot leave the domain.
ravenloft.rule.closed-domain-borders.who_may: Most Darklords can close or reopen their borders at will.
ravenloft.rule.closed-domain-borders.combines: Mists obscure sight and redirect travel.
ravenloft.rule.closed-domain-borders.blocked_reason: It combines a large-area persistent hazard with forced redirection, not represented by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.open-domain-borders.name: Open domain borders

effect.summary: Open borders avoid exhaustion, but passage through the Mists remains uncertain.

ravenloft.rule.open-domain-borders.cost_or_limit: Travel takes 1d6 hours before a random outcome is determined.
ravenloft.rule.open-domain-borders.go_wrong: Travelers may be diverted, delayed, relocated, or encounter threats.
ravenloft.rule.open-domain-borders.combines: Uses the Wandering the Mists outcomes.
ravenloft.rule.open-domain-borders.blocked_reason: The travel outcome and delay can be handled as ordinary game procedures.

ravenloft.rule.soulless-shells.name: Soulless Shells

effect.summary: The Dark Powers create inhabitants without souls from land and Mists.

ravenloft.rule.soulless-shells.cost_or_limit: Many inhabitants of each domain lack souls.
ravenloft.rule.soulless-shells.mind: They live ordinary lives that reinforce a Darklord's torment.
ravenloft.rule.soulless-shells.combines: Created people appear like the beings they represent, even under magical detection.
ravenloft.rule.soulless-shells.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot represent beings who exist without souls while otherwise appearing fully real.

ravenloft.rule.bright-souls.name: Bright Souls

effect.summary: Souled natives tend to be vivid and ambitious, but face a majority of soulless inhabitants.

ravenloft.rule.bright-souls.cost_or_limit: Applies to natives born with souls.
ravenloft.rule.bright-souls.mind: Vibrant, imaginative, and ambitious tendencies are described.
ravenloft.rule.bright-souls.who_may: Souled people born in the Land of the Mists, including native player characters
ravenloft.rule.bright-souls.blocked_reason: The rule assigns a distinct soul status and corresponding population traits.

ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.name: Death in Raven/oft

effect.summary: A dead creature's soul stays in the Mists instead of reaching the afterlife.

ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.cost_or_limit: A soul may remain trapped until reincarnation, which can take decades.
ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.go_wrong: A creature restored after at least 24 hours learns its spirit is likely trapped forever and gains a Seed of Fear.
ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.mind: Returning to life brings this frightening realization and a new fear seed.
ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.who_may: Creatures with souls that die in the Domains of Dread
ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.combines: Reincarnation may pass one soul through generations, sometimes with appearance or memory continuities.
ravenloft.rule.death-in-raven-oft.blocked_reason: The soul's post-death confinement, reincarnation, and persistence across lives are not represented by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.planar-connections.name: Planar Connections

effect.summary: Domains isolate travelers from other planes and prevent magical escape or banishment.

ravenloft.rule.planar-connections.cost_or_limit: Magic targeting the Border Ethereal can work, but entrants return to the domain when they leave it.
ravenloft.rule.planar-connections.go_wrong: Attempts to escape by planar travel fail.
ravenloft.rule.planar-connections.who_may: Applies to creatures and effects within domains.
ravenloft.rule.planar-connections.combines: Applies to spells, items, and artifacts; planar communication and summoning mostly still work.
ravenloft.rule.planar-connections.blocked_reason: It imposes a world-wide exception to planar movement and banishment, beyond a basic block effect.

ravenloft.rule.strahd-s-bond-with-barovi.name: Strahd's bond with Barovia

effect.summary: Strahd senses every creature entering Barovia and every violent death there.

ravenloft.rule.strahd-s-bond-with-barovi.combines: He takes offense when agents or domain wolves are killed.

ravenloft.rule.vistani-sanctuary.name: Vistani Sanctuary

effect.summary: Strahd avoids harming Vistani who travel in Barovia.

ravenloft.rule.vistani-sanctuary.cost_or_limit: Applies to traveling Vistani in his land.

ravenloft.rule.tatyana-s-reincarnation.name: Tatyana's reincarnation

effect.summary: Tatyana's soul repeatedly enters new physical forms.

ravenloft.rule.tatyana-s-reincarnation.go_wrong: Strahd repeatedly seeks and is rejected by each incarnation.
ravenloft.rule.tatyana-s-reincarnation.mind: The soul may bring vivid memories or dreams.
ravenloft.rule.tatyana-s-reincarnation.combines: Strahd's obsession drives the cycle's story.
ravenloft.rule.tatyana-s-reincarnation.blocked_reason: The effect moves a soul between successive bodies.

ravenloft.rule.bluetspur-s-border-memory.name: Bluetspur's border memory repression

effect.summary: When the God-Brain closes the borders, non-Aberrations who leave are returned to familiar places with their Bluetspur memories repressed or changed.

ravenloft.rule.bluetspur-s-border-memory.cost_or_limit: Applies to non-Aberrations who leave during the closure.
ravenloft.rule.bluetspur-s-border-memory.go_wrong: Memories may be altered as by modify memory.
ravenloft.rule.bluetspur-s-border-memory.combines: Uses Mists, electrical storms, and alien vapors.
ravenloft.rule.bluetspur-s-border-memory.blocked_reason: It alters and represses memories, which is beyond the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.name: Memory modification and restoration

effect.summary: Mind flayers and the Mists can obscure abduction memories; magical or other methods can recover them.

ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.cost_or_limit: Each of many alterations may need separate removal.
ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.go_wrong: An alienist may induce false memories or suggestion.
ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.mind: Memories can be obscured, replaced, or recovered.
ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.who_may: Mind flayers, Mists, or restorative magic
ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.combines: Modify memory, remove curse, and greater restoration are cited.
ravenloft.rule.memory-modification-and-r.blocked_reason: The process edits, suppresses, and restores memory.

ravenloft.rule.night-after-death-rising.name: Night-after-death rising

effect.summary: A Humanoid's corpse rises as a mindless Undead on the night after death and wanders away.

ravenloft.rule.night-after-death-rising.cost_or_limit: Locals burn bodies to prevent the rising.
ravenloft.rule.night-after-death-rising.who_may: Applies to Humanoids who die in Darkon
ravenloft.rule.night-after-death-rising.combines: Burning corpses is the local preventative practice.
ravenloft.rule.night-after-death-rising.blocked_reason: A universal death-triggered change into Undead requires a postmortem state transition.

ravenloft.rule.darkon-s-border-control.name: Darkon’s border control

effect.summary: The competing inheritors cannot open or close Darkon’s borders.

ravenloft.rule.darkon-s-border-control.cost_or_limit: Applies to the three would-be inheritors.
ravenloft.rule.darkon-s-border-control.blocked_reason: A restriction on who can change domain borders is a containment rule.

ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.name: the Shroud

effect.summary: At night, deadly Mists encroach on Darkon; by day they can be traversed normally.

ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.cost_or_limit: The threat operates at night and can advance by small increments or unstoppable floods.
ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.go_wrong: Those claimed by the surges have an unknown fate; encounters may cause damage, stress, or visions.
ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.mind: May cause stress or a glimpse of forces beyond.
ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.who_may: Creatures attempting travel or caught by the Mists.
ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.combines: Can affect travel between domains or Darkon regions.
ravenloft.rule.the-shroud.blocked_reason: The Shroud is a domain-wide moving field that damages or affects those it reaches.

ravenloft.rule.monthly-zombie-invasions.name: Monthly zombie invasions

effect.summary: On each new-moon night, a new zombie legion emerges from the Mists and attacks Falkovnia.

ravenloft.rule.monthly-zombie-invasions.cost_or_limit: Occurs monthly, and the horde appears from a different location each time.
ravenloft.rule.monthly-zombie-invasions.go_wrong: The horde is drawn toward the largest living population.
ravenloft.rule.monthly-zombie-invasions.who_may: Zombies and the living population of Falkovnia.
ravenloft.rule.monthly-zombie-invasions.combines: The attacks focus on the densest population, currently Lekar.

effect.summary: Impalement is the sole punishment for any crime in Falkovnia.

ravenloft.rule.closing-the-borders.name: Closing the Borders

effect.summary: Chakuna can raise the Mists and roughen the seas to prevent passage out of Valachan.

ravenloft.rule.closing-the-borders.cost_or_limit: Chakuna chooses when to close the borders.
ravenloft.rule.closing-the-borders.go_wrong: Deadly predators in the Mists attack creatures they encounter.
ravenloft.rule.closing-the-borders.combines: The Mists and rough seas enforce the closure.
ravenloft.rule.closing-the-borders.blocked_reason: It combines a broad regional barrier with hostile effects across the boundary.

ravenloft.rule.the-monthly-zombie-surge.name: The monthly zombie surge

effect.summary: On the new moon, zombies come from the Mists and head toward the last civilized holdouts.

ravenloft.rule.the-monthly-zombie-surge.go_wrong: The horde can besiege Lekar and threaten all survivors.
ravenloft.rule.the-monthly-zombie-surge.combines: The horde may arrive as one wave or scattered bands.
ravenloft.rule.the-monthly-zombie-surge.blocked_reason: A recurring, timed event can be represented with basic rules.

ravenloft.rule.the-gods-law.name: The Gods' Law

effect.summary: Priests are expected to maintain peace; if they fail, Ankhtepot's mummies suppress uprisings indiscriminately.

ravenloft.rule.the-gods-law.cost_or_limit: The pharaoh intervenes when priestly control fails.
ravenloft.rule.the-gods-law.who_may: Ankhtepot and his priesthood enforce it.
ravenloft.rule.the-gods-law.combines: Supports the pharaoh's rule and search for his ka.
ravenloft.rule.the-gods-law.blocked_reason: This is a world rule about authority and response, not an unsupported effect.

ravenloft.rule.ankhtepot-s-closed-border.name: Ankhtepot's closed borders

effect.summary: When Ankhtepot closes Har'Akir, sandstorms rise along its edges.

ravenloft.rule.ankhtepot-s-closed-border.cost_or_limit: Entering the storms causes 2d6 slashing damage per round.
ravenloft.rule.ankhtepot-s-closed-border.go_wrong: Travelers are battered by scouring sand.
ravenloft.rule.ankhtepot-s-closed-border.who_may: Ankhtepot chooses when to close the borders.
ravenloft.rule.ankhtepot-s-closed-border.combines: The storms act with the Mists.
ravenloft.rule.ankhtepot-s-closed-border.blocked_reason: The storm applies ongoing damage across an area, which requires an area-field effect.

ravenloft.rule.unreliable-magic-in-hazla.name: Unreliable magic in Hazlan

effect.summary: Magic in Hazlan is unreliable and can produce dangerous side effects.

ravenloft.rule.unreliable-magic-in-hazla.cost_or_limit: Magic use carries a risk of adverse effects.
ravenloft.rule.unreliable-magic-in-hazla.go_wrong: Side effects may be dangerous and the environment is scarred by magical disasters.
ravenloft.rule.unreliable-magic-in-hazla.who_may: Anyone using magic in Hazlan may be affected.
ravenloft.rule.unreliable-magic-in-hazla.combines: The domain's magical experiments worsen the instability.
ravenloft.rule.unreliable-magic-in-hazla.blocked_reason: The passage gives no rules for determining or resolving unpredictable magical side effects.

ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-fall.name: The Lacuna's fall

effect.summary: Entering the Lacuna's fog causes a fall as if into a ravine; few return.

ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-fall.cost_or_limit: Triggered by stepping into the fog.
ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-fall.go_wrong: The fall is often fatal or leaves the victim lost.
ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-fall.blocked_reason: The rule depends on a persistent environmental field affecting entrants.

ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-magical-grow.name: The Lacuna's magical growth

effect.summary: The fog spreads toward powerful magic; magical sigils have slowed and split its growth.

ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-magical-grow.cost_or_limit: Growth is slowed by the sigils, not stopped.
ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-magical-grow.combines: Drawn toward strong magic and altered by magical sigils.
ravenloft.rule.the-lacuna-s-magical-grow.blocked_reason: The rule combines persistent territorial spread with attraction to sources of magic.

ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.name: Eye of Hazlik's daily protection

effect.summary: A person openly wearing the symbol may skip one Wild Magic table roll each day.

ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.cost_or_limit: Once per day; requires openly wearing the symbol.
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.go_wrong: The wearer remains subject to other wild magic effects.
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.who_may: Anyone openly wearing an Eye of Hazlik
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.combines: The Eye also enables Hazlik's surveillance.
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.mechanism: Daily use limit and effect avoidance
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-s-daily-pro.blocked_reason: A wearable item grants a limited-use protective ability.

ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-surveillanc.name: Eye of Hazlik surveillance

effect.summary: Hazlik senses spells and magic-item use near an Eye, then may spy through any one as an arcane eye.

ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-surveillanc.cost_or_limit: Sensing reaches 30 feet; spying may last as long as Hazlik wishes.
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-surveillanc.go_wrong: Use of the sigil exposes magic users to Hazlik.
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-surveillanc.combines: He learns spell level and magic-item rarity.
ravenloft.rule.eye-of-hazlik-surveillanc.blocked_reason: The rule grants ongoing remote detection and vision through distributed symbols.

ravenloft.rule.nightingale-bell-dream-up.name: Nightingale Bell dream upkeep

effect.summary: Tsien Chiang must ring the bell daily or the dream fades and everyone wakes.

ravenloft.rule.nightingale-bell-dream-up.cost_or_limit: Once each day; only Tsien Chiang can maintain the dream.
ravenloft.rule.nightingale-bell-dream-up.go_wrong: If not rung, the shared dream ends.
ravenloft.rule.nightingale-bell-dream-up.combines: The bell can be rung by anyone to enter the dream bodily.
ravenloft.rule.nightingale-bell-dream-up.blocked_reason: The mechanism maintains a domain-wide shared dream affecting sleepers.

ravenloft.rule.dream-death.name: dream death

effect.summary: Dying in the dream causes psychic harm and returns the creature to waking life without rest benefits.

ravenloft.rule.dream-death.go_wrong: The dreamer receives no benefit from the rest that ended.
ravenloft.rule.dream-death.mind: Death in the dream causes psychic injury.
ravenloft.rule.dream-death.combines: A bodily entrant who dies in the dream dies for real.
ravenloft.rule.dream-death.blocked_reason: The rule distinguishes dream death from real death, with a separate exception for bodily entrants.

ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.name: dream entry and waking

effect.summary: Sleepers enter the dream; characters without exhaustion wake after six hours, while exhausted ones may repeatedly attempt a Wisdom save to wake.

ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.cost_or_limit: Exhausted characters retry after each six-hour period; the DC is 10.
ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.go_wrong: Failing the save prolongs the dream by another six hours.
ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.mind: The dream traps sleepers and affects meditating creatures without sleep.
ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.who_may: Anyone sleeping in I'Cath; nonsleepers may enter by meditating.
ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.combines: Long rests spent partly in the dream do not remove exhaustion.
ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.mechanism: Sleep-triggered dream entry and escape check
ravenloft.rule.dream-entry-and-waking.blocked_reason: The shared dream captures sleepers and controls their waking state.

ravenloft.rule.dream-rest-limitation.name: dream rest limitation

effect.summary: A long rest in I'Cath does not remove exhaustion if any part is spent in the dream.

ravenloft.rule.dream-rest-limitation.cost_or_limit: Applies if any part of the rest occurs in Tsien Chiang's dream.
ravenloft.rule.dream-rest-limitation.combines: Dream entry is caused by sleep.

ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.name: dreaming daughters disrupt the dream

effect.summary: If all four waking daughters sleep, they replace their dream doubles; Tsien Chiang is horrified and flees the dream.

ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.cost_or_limit: All four daughters must fall asleep.
ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.go_wrong: The intrusion causes Tsien Chiang to flee her dream.
ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.mind: The daughters' comfort and sleep affect the dream.
ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.who_may: Those helping all four daughters sleep
ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.combines: Disrupts the shared dream and may free its inhabitants.
ravenloft.rule.dreaming-daughters-disrup.blocked_reason: The rule changes dream identities and affects a domain-wide shared dream.

ravenloft.rule.deathless-loyalty.name: Deathless Loyalty

effect.summary: A soldier who dies serving Ramya returns as an undead warrior on the next new moon and rejoins her army.

ravenloft.rule.deathless-loyalty.cost_or_limit: Applies to living soldiers who die in Ramya’s service; return occurs on the next new moon.
ravenloft.rule.deathless-loyalty.where_from: Ramya’s power and the domain’s supernatural conditions.
ravenloft.rule.deathless-loyalty.combines: The returned warrior is a skeleton or wight.
ravenloft.rule.deathless-loyalty.blocked_reason: It restores the dead as undead beings and preserves their allegiance.

ravenloft.rule.border-control-requires-t.name: Border control requires the Sapphire Throne

effect.summary: Ramya can open or close Kalakeri’s borders only while she controls the Sapphire Throne.

ravenloft.rule.border-control-requires-t.cost_or_limit: If Ramya loses Jadurai, borders remain unchanged until she regains control.
ravenloft.rule.border-control-requires-t.who_may: Ramya, while she controls the throne.
ravenloft.rule.border-control-requires-t.combines: The effect depends on control of the Sapphire Throne.
ravenloft.rule.border-control-requires-t.blocked_reason: The rule alters the borders of an entire domain.

ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.name: wrong-temple treasure curse

effect.summary: A person who claims the wish-granting treasure in the wrong temple becomes a wyvern loyal to Kalakeri’s true leader.

ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.cost_or_limit: Triggered by claiming the treasure at the wrong temple.
ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.go_wrong: The claimant is transformed and made loyal to the domain’s true leader.
ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.mind: The transformed person is loyal to the true leader.
ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.where_from: A curse associated with the Vochalam temples.
ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.combines: The treasure’s location and temple choice determine the outcome.
ravenloft.rule.wrong-temple-treasure-cur.blocked_reason: It changes a claimant into a wyvern and imposes loyalty.

ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.name: Kartakass border closure

effect.summary: When Harkon closes the borders, a soothing song fills the Mists; exhausted creatures reduced to speed zero fall unconscious and are sent to the Kartakass edge.

ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.cost_or_limit: Applies when Harkon closes the borders and a creature in the Mists reaches speed zero from exhaustion.
ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.go_wrong: The creature is expelled from the Mists and wakes later at their Kartakass edge.
ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.mind: The song is soothing; affected creatures fall unconscious.
ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.who_may: Creatures caught in the Mists during closure.
ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.combines: Expulsion is triggered by exhaustion reducing speed to zero.
ravenloft.rule.kartakass-border-closure.blocked_reason: It affects creatures throughout the Mists and transports them to a domain boundary.

ravenloft.rule.harkon-s-bite-curse-and-r.name: Harkon's Bite curse and removal

effect.summary: Attunement curses the wearer so the necklace cannot be removed unless Harkon removes it or remove curse or similar magic ends the curse.

ravenloft.rule.harkon-s-bite-curse-and-r.cost_or_limit: The restriction lasts until one of the stated means ends it.
ravenloft.rule.harkon-s-bite-curse-and-r.go_wrong: The wearer remains unable to remove the necklace while cursed.
ravenloft.rule.harkon-s-bite-curse-and-r.combines: The curse accompanies the necklace’s lycanthropy effect.
ravenloft.rule.harkon-s-bite-curse-and-r.blocked_reason: The rule changes the wearer’s ability to remove the item and depends on dispelling or intervention.

ravenloft.rule.death-in-mordent.name: Death in Mordent

effect.summary: A person who dies in Mordent returns after 24 hours as an incorporeal Undead unless restored or otherwise removed.

ravenloft.rule.death-in-mordent.cost_or_limit: Restoration to life works normally; otherwise the spirit persists until destroyed or claimed by the Mists.
ravenloft.rule.death-in-mordent.who_may: Applies to anyone who dies in Mordent.
ravenloft.rule.death-in-mordent.blocked_reason: The rule defines post-mortem existence and return as an Undead spirit.

ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.name: Possession by bound spirits

effect.summary: Spirits bound to Gryphon Hill may possess the living only when Godefroy commands it.

ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.cost_or_limit: Possession is restricted by the Darklord’s permission.
ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.mind: The spirit takes control of a living host.
ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.who_may: Spirits capable of possession, with Godefroy’s command.
ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.where_from: House on Gryphon Hill and its grounds
ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.combines: Used to advance Godefroy’s aims elsewhere or enlarge the manor.
ravenloft.rule.possession-by-bound-spiri.blocked_reason: Possession lets a spirit control a living creature and is governed by a command restriction.

ravenloft.rule.plague-seasons.name: Plague Seasons

effect.summary: Wererat alchemists brew changing plague strains and infect rats to spread them.

ravenloft.rule.plague-seasons.cost_or_limit: Strains can differ subtly, allowing repeated infections.
ravenloft.rule.plague-seasons.go_wrong: The resulting diseases can become increasingly virulent.
ravenloft.rule.plague-seasons.combines: Plague strains are carried by infected rats.
ravenloft.rule.plague-seasons.blocked_reason: This is a world mechanism describing how plague strains are made and spread.

ravenloft.rule.immune-renier-family.name: Immune Renier family

effect.summary: The Renier family proved immune to the Gnawing Plague.

ravenloft.rule.immune-renier-family.cost_or_limit: Applies to the Reniers as described.
ravenloft.rule.immune-renier-family.combines: The plague killed the royal dynasty and many nobles.
ravenloft.rule.immune-renier-family.blocked_reason: This is a direct rule about who the disease can affect.

ravenloft.rule.plague-cycle-survival.name: Plague-cycle survival

effect.summary: The plague never kills everyone in Richemulot; cures or Renier’s withdrawal of rats allow communities to repopulate.

ravenloft.rule.plague-cycle-survival.cost_or_limit: The plague’s cycle can wax or wane over days or weeks.
ravenloft.rule.plague-cycle-survival.go_wrong: A community can be devastated, but the domain repopulates.
ravenloft.rule.plague-cycle-survival.combines: New residents emerge from the Mists.
ravenloft.rule.plague-cycle-survival.blocked_reason: The account describes people reappearing from the Mists after catastrophic deaths without specifying ordinary survival.

ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-transmissi.name: Gnawing Plague transmission

effect.summary: A bite from a listed carrier or contact with an infected creature can transmit the disease.

ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-transmissi.cost_or_limit: Exposure requires a Constitution save to resist; the base difficulty is 10.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-transmissi.who_may: Creatures exposed to infected rats, giant rats, rat swarms, wererats, or infected creatures.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-transmissi.combines: Plague-stage severity can raise the saving-throw difficulty.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-transmissi.blocked_reason: The rule is expressible as a disease effect with an exposure check.

ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-symptoms.name: Gnawing Plague symptoms

effect.summary: After one or two days, infection causes exhaustion and reduces recovery from rest.

ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-symptoms.cost_or_limit: Infected creatures regain only half their usual hit points from Hit Dice and none from a long rest.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-symptoms.go_wrong: Symptoms include fatigue, rashes, sweats, tremors, and buboes.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-symptoms.combines: Recovery is resolved with saving throws after long rests.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-symptoms.blocked_reason: The specific exhaustion and hit-point recovery rules need capabilities outside the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-recovery.name: Gnawing Plague recovery

effect.summary: A successful daily save reduces exhaustion and eventually ends the infection.

ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-recovery.cost_or_limit: At each long rest, a DC 10 Constitution save determines whether exhaustion rises or falls.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-recovery.go_wrong: A failed save adds exhaustion; recovery takes repeated successes if needed.
ravenloft.rule.gnawing-plague-recovery.blocked_reason: Repeated saving throws and exhaustion tracking are not represented by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.immunity-to-the-gnawing-p.name: Immunity to the Gnawing Plague

effect.summary: All forms of rats and wererats cannot contract the disease.

ravenloft.rule.immunity-to-the-gnawing-p.where_from: The Gnawing Plague’s stated immunity rule.
ravenloft.rule.immunity-to-the-gnawing-p.combines: These creatures can still carry or spread the disease.
ravenloft.rule.immunity-to-the-gnawing-p.blocked_reason: This is a direct rule about who the disease can affect.

ravenloft.rule.laoirse-s-tithe-lifespan.name: Laoirse’s Tithe lifespan

effect.summary: A villager sacrificed at the Tithe extends the latest Laoirse’s life by a few weeks.

ravenloft.rule.laoirse-s-tithe-lifespan.cost_or_limit: The extension is only a few weeks; the creature otherwise decays quickly.
ravenloft.rule.laoirse-s-tithe-lifespan.combines: The victim is killed by Laoirse.
ravenloft.rule.laoirse-s-tithe-lifespan.blocked_reason: The sacrifice transfers additional lifespan to another creature.

ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.name: Mother's Tithe

effect.summary: At each seasonal festival, Laoirse attacks and kills the selected sacrifice.

ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.cost_or_limit: The festival occurs four times a year at equinoxes and solstices.
ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.go_wrong: A victim is slaughtered; their death is presented as a fertility offering.
ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.mind: Villagers are conditioned to accept the sacrifice as necessary.
ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.who_may: Lorinda and the latest Laoirse enact the rite; villagers assemble.
ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.combines: The sacrifice gives fields fertility and extends Laoirse’s life.
ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.mechanism: Ritual sacrifice with agricultural and lifespan effects.
ravenloft.rule.mother-s-tithe.blocked_reason: The victim’s death is linked to a transfer of lifespan and fertility.

ravenloft.rule.the-forests-watch.name: The forests watch

effect.summary: The forest observes events and whispers what it sees to Chakuna.

ravenloft.rule.the-forests-watch.combines: Connects the forest’s awareness to Chakuna.
ravenloft.rule.the-forests-watch.blocked_reason: The forest-wide sensing and reporting network is an area effect beyond the basic target grammar.

ravenloft.rule.trial-of-hearts.name: Trial of Hearts

effect.summary: A full-moon hunt in which Chakuna pits selected contenders against one another.

ravenloft.rule.trial-of-hearts.cost_or_limit: Selected contenders must survive the hunt and reach a shrine; violations are punishable by death.
ravenloft.rule.trial-of-hearts.go_wrong: Losers die in the jungle; Chakuna may alter the rules.
ravenloft.rule.trial-of-hearts.combines: Uses Pantara Lodge, hunting partners, shrines, and the domain’s hostile wilderness.

ravenloft.rule.chakuna-s-heart-sustains-.name: Chakuna’s heart sustains her domain bond

effect.summary: Chakuna’s beating heart is linked to Valachan and sustains her rule.

ravenloft.rule.chakuna-s-heart-sustains-.cost_or_limit: She must sacrifice hunted blood to maintain the bond.
ravenloft.rule.chakuna-s-heart-sustains-.go_wrong: Without sacrifice, the domain’s plants and animals become hostile.
ravenloft.rule.chakuna-s-heart-sustains-.combines: The heart and the land function as a connected nexus.
ravenloft.rule.chakuna-s-heart-sustains-.blocked_reason: The continuing metaphysical link between a heart, a ruler, and a domain is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.trial-rules-and-winners.name: Trial rules and winners

effect.summary: Fifteen selected contenders may group initially, cannot form later alliances, and must reach one of two shrines to win.

ravenloft.rule.trial-rules-and-winners.cost_or_limit: Chakuna hunts at dusk; the trial continues until she recognizes winners at both shrines.
ravenloft.rule.trial-rules-and-winners.go_wrong: Rule violations are punishable by death; losers die in the jungle.
ravenloft.rule.trial-rules-and-winners.combines: Chakuna can close borders and alter the rules; the Mists can enforce travel restrictions.

ravenloft.rule.valachan-travel-condition.name: Valachan travel conditions

effect.summary: Dense jungle halves travel pace, while strong winds slow flight.

ravenloft.rule.valachan-travel-condition.cost_or_limit: Chakuna ignores the wilderness’s difficult terrain.
ravenloft.rule.valachan-travel-condition.go_wrong: Travel may be further slowed by hazards or made impossible by trial rules.
ravenloft.rule.valachan-travel-condition.who_may: Travelers in Valachan; Chakuna is exempt from the terrain penalty.
ravenloft.rule.valachan-travel-condition.combines: Chakuna may prohibit flight or magical travel, with the Mists enforcing the restriction.
ravenloft.rule.valachan-travel-condition.blocked_reason: Terrain and winds apply broad movement modifiers, and the Mists enforce area-wide travel bans.

ravenloft.rule.destroying-chakuna-s-hear.name: Destroying Chakuna’s heart

effect.summary: Destroying Chakuna’s heart prevents her from recovering if slain.

ravenloft.rule.destroying-chakuna-s-hear.cost_or_limit: Her heart must be found and destroyed.
ravenloft.rule.destroying-chakuna-s-hear.go_wrong: If her heart is instead replaced by a character’s heart, that character takes her mantle and becomes trapped in Valachan.
ravenloft.rule.destroying-chakuna-s-hear.who_may: Anyone who finds the heart; a would-be successor may replace it.
ravenloft.rule.destroying-chakuna-s-hear.combines: The heart’s destruction defeats Chakuna; replacing it can transfer her mantle and protect allies.
ravenloft.rule.destroying-chakuna-s-hear.blocked_reason: The rule governs recovery after death and the transfer of a Darklord’s mantle through a heart.

ravenloft.rule.the-mists-can-carry-trave.name: The Mists can carry travelers between lands and can be coerced but never controlled.

effect.summary: The Mists can transport travelers, but cannot be controlled.

ravenloft.rule.the-mists-can-carry-trave.cost_or_limit: They can be coerced, not controlled.
ravenloft.rule.the-mists-can-carry-trave.go_wrong: Passage can be dangerous or lead to unintended destinations.
ravenloft.rule.the-mists-can-carry-trave.combines: Mist talismans and the Mist Walker Dark Gift can aid travel.
ravenloft.rule.the-mists-can-carry-trave.blocked_reason: This is a world rule rather than a character power.

ravenloft.rule.time-reality-and-memory-d.name: Time, reality, and memory don't always move in reliable ways, particularly between domains.

effect.summary: Time, reality, and memory may behave inconsistently across domains.

ravenloft.rule.time-reality-and-memory-d.mechanism: Cross-domain temporal, reality, and memory instability
ravenloft.rule.time-reality-and-memory-d.blocked_reason: The rule describes broad instability without defining a runnable alteration.

ravenloft.rule.one-might-glimpse-their-f.name: One might glimpse their fortune, but such things endlessly shift. Every soul makes their own fate.

effect.summary: Fortunes can be glimpsed but are changeable; individuals determine their own fate.

ravenloft.rule.one-might-glimpse-their-f.cost_or_limit: A glimpse of fortune is not fixed.
ravenloft.rule.one-might-glimpse-their-f.blocked_reason: The rule concerns foresight and mutable fate, which the basic effect grammar cannot model.

ravenloft.rule.caravan-leaders-ensure-th.name: Caravan leaders ensure that every family member is accounted for before moving on, ensuring no one gets lost in the Mists.

effect.summary: Vistani leaders check that all family members are present before a caravan enters the Mists.

ravenloft.rule.caravan-leaders-ensure-th.cost_or_limit: Caravan movement waits until everyone is accounted for.
ravenloft.rule.caravan-leaders-ensure-th.go_wrong: People may otherwise get lost in the Mists.
ravenloft.rule.caravan-leaders-ensure-th.blocked_reason: This is a world practice, not an unsupported supernatural effect.

ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.name: Live you always among monsters, and see everyone you love die beneath their claws.

effect.summary: Rudolph’s curse brings about the deaths of those he loves through monsters.

ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.cost_or_limit: Afflicts Rudolph and concerns those he loves.
ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.go_wrong: Loved ones die beneath monsters’ claws.
ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.mind: Causes fear and distance from loved ones.
ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.who_may: Inflicted on Rudolph by Irena Radanavich.
ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.combines: Its effects unfolded in the weeks after it was spoken.
ravenloft.rule.live-you-always-among-mon.blocked_reason: The curse’s long-term, conditional effects on multiple people are not defined by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.no-matter-how-many-times-.name: no matter how many times it's defeated, it always returns

effect.summary: The Caller returns after being defeated.

ravenloft.rule.no-matter-how-many-times-.go_wrong: Defeating the Caller does not prevent its return.
ravenloft.rule.no-matter-how-many-times-.blocked_reason: The passage gives no mechanism for the Caller’s repeated return.

ravenloft.rule.dramatic-curse-resolution.name: Dramatic curse resolution

effect.summary: Specific dramatic curses require their prescribed remedy and cannot be permanently ended by spells.

ravenloft.rule.dramatic-curse-resolution.cost_or_limit: Remove curse suppresses the burden for 1 hour; greater restoration suppresses it until the next long rest. Death ends it temporarily, but it returns if the victim returns to life without resolving it.
ravenloft.rule.dramatic-curse-resolution.who_may: Applies to victims of specific or dramatic curses.
ravenloft.rule.dramatic-curse-resolution.where_from: Curse rules described in the passage.
ravenloft.rule.dramatic-curse-resolution.combines: Persistent curses may allow a Charisma save to remove them after resolution.
ravenloft.rule.dramatic-curse-resolution.blocked_reason: The curse’s conditional burden, temporary suppression, death interaction, and return on revival need curse-state tracking beyond the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.persistent-curses.name: Persistent Curses

effect.summary: Some curses linger after resolution and can be removed by magic only after a successful Charisma save.

ravenloft.rule.persistent-curses.cost_or_limit: The save is usually DC 15 and can be retried after a set interval, usually one month; the DC may be adjusted from 10 to 20.
ravenloft.rule.persistent-curses.go_wrong: A failed save leaves the curse in place until another attempt.
ravenloft.rule.persistent-curses.where_from: Curse rules described in the passage.
ravenloft.rule.persistent-curses.combines: Can be removed by remove curse or similar magic after a successful save.
ravenloft.rule.persistent-curses.blocked_reason: A curse persisting after its resolution with timed repeat saves requires ongoing state and retry tracking.

ravenloft.rule.stress-score.name: Stress Score

effect.summary: Stress rises in trying situations and penalizes attacks, checks, and saves; rest and restoration magic can reduce or suppress it.

ravenloft.rule.stress-score.cost_or_limit: Stress may increase by 1 for listed events; a calm day followed by a long rest reduces it by 1. Lesser restoration reduces it by 1, greater restoration to 0, and calm emotions suppresses its penalties for the spell’s duration.
ravenloft.rule.stress-score.go_wrong: Stress can accumulate and worsen rolls.
ravenloft.rule.stress-score.mind: Models the lingering toll of dread and despair.
ravenloft.rule.stress-score.combines: Uses long rests and the effects of named spells.
ravenloft.rule.stress-score.blocked_reason: Tracking a numeric score and applying it as a penalty to several roll types is not expressible by the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.name: Haunted traps

effect.summary: Negative emotions, tragedy, or evil can manifest as traps in an area.

ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.cost_or_limit: Each trap has an emanation before activation; passive Perception can reveal it, allowing a character until the next turn begins to respond.
ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.go_wrong: A trap may activate against trespassers.
ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.who_may: Characters can detect and attempt to disarm a noticed trap.
ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.where_from: They arise spontaneously in an area from overwhelming negative emotions, tragedy, or evil.
ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.combines: Certain class features, spells, or history-related nonmagical methods can detect or disarm them.
ravenloft.rule.haunted-traps.blocked_reason: The rule makes supernatural traps manifest in an area and requires detection, activation, and disarming procedures beyond the basic effect grammar.

ravenloft.rule.haunted-trap-disarming-du.name: Haunted-trap disarming duration

effect.summary: A trap disarmed by the described methods usually stays disarmed for 24 hours.

ravenloft.rule.haunted-trap-disarming-du.blocked_reason: This is a direct duration limit.

ravenloft.rule.morbid-memory-trap-reacti.name: Morbid memory trap reactivation

effect.summary: After activation, the trap cannot activate again for 24 hours.

ravenloft.rule.morbid-memory-trap-reacti.blocked_reason: This is a direct timing restriction.

ravenloft.rule.house-of-lament-repairs-d.name: House of Lament repairs damage

effect.summary: Damage to the dormant house repairs after a day; once awake, it heals immediately.

ravenloft.rule.house-of-lament-repairs-d.cost_or_limit: Repairs are delayed while dormant and immediate after awakening.
ravenloft.rule.house-of-lament-repairs-d.go_wrong: Awakening may expose horrifying spaces through the repairs.
ravenloft.rule.house-of-lament-repairs-d.who_may: Applies to damage to the house.
ravenloft.rule.house-of-lament-repairs-d.combines: The house resists damage; soggy wood also stops fire spreading while dormant.

ravenloft.rule.mists-bar-departure-from-.name: Mists bar departure from the grounds

effect.summary: Anyone entering the surrounding haze is led back to the house.

ravenloft.rule.mists-bar-departure-from-.cost_or_limit: Applies when someone tries to leave the grounds.
ravenloft.rule.mists-bar-departure-from-.go_wrong: The traveler returns to the house instead of escaping.
ravenloft.rule.mists-bar-departure-from-.where_from: The Mists around the House of Lament.
ravenloft.rule.mists-bar-departure-from-.combines: The same misty force draws people to the house.

ravenloft.rule.arcane-lock-suppression.name: Arcane lock suppression

effect.summary: Presenting belladonna suppresses the sanctuary door’s lock for ten minutes.

ravenloft.rule.arcane-lock-suppression.cost_or_limit: Requires a belladonna sprig and lasts ten minutes.
ravenloft.rule.arcane-lock-suppression.go_wrong: The door emits a radiant blast when damaged but takes no damage.
ravenloft.rule.arcane-lock-suppression.where_from: The protected door to the children’s bedroom.
ravenloft.rule.arcane-lock-suppression.combines: Belladonna from the conservatory can serve.

ravenloft.rule.theodora-s-room-ward-ends.name: Theodora’s room ward ends after entry and exit

effect.summary: When a visitor enters and then leaves the children’s room, the blessing ends and the house awakens.

ravenloft.rule.theodora-s-room-ward-ends.cost_or_limit: Triggered by entering and exiting the room.
ravenloft.rule.theodora-s-room-ward-ends.go_wrong: The children’s spirits become visible to other apparitions.
ravenloft.rule.theodora-s-room-ward-ends.who_may: Anyone entering and leaving the room.
ravenloft.rule.theodora-s-room-ward-ends.where_from: The blessing protecting the nursery bedroom.
ravenloft.rule.theodora-s-room-ward-ends.combines: The ward’s end exposes Regan and Vastion.

ravenloft.rule.bodytaker-plant-rejuvenat.name: Bodytaker plant Rejuvenation

effect.summary: A dead plant returns after 1d12 months unless its rooted ground is salted or poisoned.

ravenloft.rule.bodytaker-plant-rejuvenat.cost_or_limit: Salt or poison in the ground prevents return.
ravenloft.rule.bodytaker-plant-rejuvenat.combines: Plant destruction does not suffice if root filaments remain.
ravenloft.rule.bodytaker-plant-rejuvenat.mechanism: Delayed regeneration with a material countermeasure.
ravenloft.rule.bodytaker-plant-rejuvenat.blocked_reason: The plant’s return from surviving roots requires a persistent regeneration state.

ravenloft.rule.jiangshi-weaknesses.name: Jiangshi Weaknesses

effect.summary: A jiangshi flees its own reflection and automatically fails saves against turning while wearing or touching a holy symbol.

ravenloft.rule.jiangshi-weaknesses.cost_or_limit: Reflection prompts flight if a reaction is available; holy-symbol vulnerability applies while in contact.
ravenloft.rule.jiangshi-weaknesses.combines: Holy symbols interact with effects that turn undead.
ravenloft.rule.jiangshi-weaknesses.blocked_reason: The listed responses can be implemented as conditions and save modifiers.

ravenloft.rule.loup-garou-lycanthropy.name: Loup garou lycanthropy

effect.summary: An afflicted humanoid becomes a werewolf, and the curse persists while its source lives.

ravenloft.rule.loup-garou-lycanthropy.cost_or_limit: After the source dies, a remove curse spell must be cast on the full-moon night; a successful DC 17 Constitution save breaks it and causes three exhaustion levels.
ravenloft.rule.loup-garou-lycanthropy.go_wrong: Failure leaves the curse and prevents further attempts to break it for one month.
ravenloft.rule.loup-garou-lycanthropy.who_may: Humanoids afflicted by a loup garou.
ravenloft.rule.loup-garou-lycanthropy.combines: Requires the source's death and a removal spell under specific conditions.
ravenloft.rule.loup-garou-lycanthropy.blocked_reason: The rule changes the victim's creature form and preserves a persistent curse state.

ravenloft.rule.nosferatu-transformation.name: Nosferatu transformation

effect.summary: A humanoid slain by the nosferatu's bite and then buried rises as a nosferatu after 1d10 days.

ravenloft.rule.nosferatu-transformation.cost_or_limit: Requires death by the bite and burial.
ravenloft.rule.nosferatu-transformation.who_may: Humanoids slain by a nosferatu bite.
ravenloft.rule.nosferatu-transformation.combines: Requires burial after the fatal bite.
ravenloft.rule.nosferatu-transformation.blocked_reason: The rule specifies a state change after death and a delay.

ravenloft.rule.tattoo-of-osybus.name: Tattoo of Osybus

effect.summary: At zero hit points, a priest may gain an unused boon and revive as undead with half its hit points.

ravenloft.rule.tattoo-of-osybus.cost_or_limit: The tattoo must be destroyed to prevent revival; it is invulnerable while the priest has hit points and rapidly restores its own hit points during combat.
ravenloft.rule.tattoo-of-osybus.go_wrong: Receiving a boon already possessed kills the priest.
ravenloft.rule.tattoo-of-osybus.where_from: Osybus's deathly gift, shown as a shadowy tattoo.
ravenloft.rule.tattoo-of-osybus.combines: Revival outcome depends on the Boons of Undeath table.
ravenloft.rule.tattoo-of-osybus.blocked_reason: The rule specifies revival after death and changes the priest's state and type.

ravenloft.rule.strigoi-victim-remains.name: Strigoi victim remains

effect.summary: A person killed by a strigoi’s proboscis attack may leave only skin and equipment; some victims reanimate as boneless.

ravenloft.rule.strigoi-victim-remains.cost_or_limit: Applies to victims reduced to zero hit points by the proboscis.
ravenloft.rule.strigoi-victim-remains.combines: May result in a boneless creature.
ravenloft.rule.strigoi-victim-remains.blocked_reason: The potential reanimation and unusual post-death state require death-state handling.

ravenloft.rule.mist-horror-cohesion.name: Mist horror cohesion

effect.summary: A mist horror outside the Mists collapses into harmless vapor after 1d4 rounds.

ravenloft.rule.mist-horror-cohesion.go_wrong: The horror loses cohesion and ceases to function.
ravenloft.rule.mist-horror-cohesion.blocked_reason: A delayed ending after a set duration is representable.

ravenloft.rule.body-composition.name: Body Composition

effect.summary: An unspeakable horror has one of four body compositions: Aberrant Armor, Loathsome Limbs, Malleable Mass, or Oozing Organs.

ravenloft.rule.body-composition.cost_or_limit: One composition is selected or rolled; conflicting table results may be resolved by choosing a preferred result.
